text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, somatropin 30 mg/3 mL syringes (NDC 00169770321, labeler Novo Nordisk) used at Corvale General and Corvale East are linked to a product FDA lists as To Be Discontinued since 2023-01-06. Current stock: Corvale East has 8 syringes (2 days); Corvale General has 64 syringes (14.8 days); Corvale Lakeside has 9 syringes (12.4 days). Corvale East also has 38 cartridges (8.9 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA records show the product status is To Be Discontinued effective 2023-01-06. SPL set 1058e17c identifies two manufacturing plants: Novo Nordisk A/S - Hax (FEI 3002807748) and Novo Nordisk A/S - Kv (FEI 3015545250). Inspection 1167028 at Kv ended 2021-11-18, classified VAI, 414 days before the shortage posting. Inspection 1238387 at Hax ended 2023-06-01, classified VAI, 146 days after the posting. Inspection 1341150 at Kv ended 2024-05-02, classified VAI, 482 days after the posting.

Our position: The discontinuation status and limited inventory at Corvale East require immediate internal redistribution to maintain supply. External alternatives exist but are not on FDA’s shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 3 syringes of somatropin 30 mg/3 mL, 3 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
2. Transfer 8 syringes of somatropin 2.88 mL cartridge from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
3. Evaluate purchase from Sandoz Inc — requires buyer action.
4. Evaluate purchase from EMD Serono, Inc. — requires buyer action.
5. Evaluate purchase from Ferring Pharmaceuticals Inc. — requires buyer action.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol modifications; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
